lines-pair.note: two line families at 4°, plain composite

lines-pair-envelope.note: the same pair enveloped: broad diagonal fringes, carrier gone

lines-pair-contours.note: contours at integer D over the envelope

lines-pair-ratio.note: the heterodyne ratio map of the pair

lines-pair-mask.note: envelope with the regime mask most of the way up

lines-trio-contours.note: three families at 0/3/9° — the third joins the character scan

rings-pair-envelope.note: two ring families off-centre: the two-centre fringe system

rings-pair-contours.note: the character-hills skeleton: contours of D between ring centres

rings-pair-contours-zoom2.note: the same skeleton at scene zoom 2 — guards the capture framing math

squares-pair-contours.note: square rings at a 10° twist — piecewise index fields with corners

radial-pair-contours.note: two radial fans off-centre — the sector-count scalar under contours

line-ring-contours.note: mixed classes: a line family against a ring family

wave-pair-envelope.note: two wave families at 5° — bent index fields enveloped

spiral-ring-envelope.note: a spiral against rings — unequal index gradients everywhere

line-field-envelope.note: a Gaussian-warped line family against a plain twin, enveloped

line-field-contours.note: the warped pair under contours — level sets of the field itself

grid-twist-envelope.note: the square-lattice twist pair — both slow characters survive the sweep

grid-twist-contours.note: contours on the twist pair — the class the first lattice-contours bug hid in

grid-hex-twist-contours.note: hex lattices at 3° — three families, two generators, under contours

grid-tri-line-contours.note: a triangle lattice against a scalar partner — the line family is set parallel to a lattice edge family (pitch (√3/2)·16 ≈ 13.86 at 30°) so a real slow beat exists for the contour channel to draw

grid-trio-twist-contours.note: three square lattices at 0/2.5/5° — the third joins the lockstep sweep

grid-field-envelope.note: the dipole-field grid pair from the bug report, enveloped

grid-field-contours.note: the same pair under contours — the fix that seeded this zoo

single-ring-envelope.note: one scalar family alone — the A == B envelope fallback

single-grid-envelope.note: one lattice alone — the sweep washes it to its cell mean

grid-lines-ratio.note: ratio view over a grid and two scalars — the ranking must skip the grid
